# Media Object

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:MediaObject`](gmeow-MediaObject.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/MediaObject>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)

An image, audio, or video media file — a concrete published artifact. A specialization of [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:MediaObject`](gmeow-MediaObject.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Manifestation`](gmeow-Manifestation.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
